mechanism.falsifier: Exact-tree review shows lost lifetime protection, incorrect slot conflict handling, or broken cache lookup fallback. Correctness, metadata spread <1%, and calibrated fast-tier screen independently gate execution.

candidates.hypothesis: Lifting the zswap mTHP swapin blackout in mm/memory.c when an aligned contiguous swap cluster resides in zswap and assembling contiguous compressed slots into high-order folios (orders 2 and 4) eliminates repeated PTL acquisitions and per-page fault overhead, compounding Milestone 1's allocator-first engine to achieve an 8% to 12% geomean latency improvement without regressions or correctness violations.

mechanism.claim: In mm/memory.c, thp_swapin_suitable_orders() checks zswap_all_present() across candidate orders 2 and 4 instead of unconditionally returning 0 when zswap is active, and do_swap_page() routes orders > 1 directly to swapin_sync(). In mm/zswap.c, zswap_all_present() verifies contiguous slot residency under RCU, and zswap_load() uses two-phase commit subpage decompression into kmap_local_folio subpage offsets, atomically installing all PTEs via set_ptes() under a single PTL hold.
mechanism.falsifier: Exact-tree review shows lost lifetime protection, incorrect slot conflict handling, missing order-0 fallback, or broken RCU presence checking. Correctness gates, metadata spread <1%, and calibrated fast-tier screen independently gate execution.

candidates.hypothesis: Replacing flat VM_SPARSE descriptor tables with 2-level RCU radix chunks and asynchronous kfree_rcu() reclamation eliminates interior metadata retention plateaus and synchronize_rcu() latency stalls, compounding Milestones 1 and 2 to pass all 17 correctness gates with >60% metadata memory savings on fragmented swap.

mechanism.claim: In mm/swapfile.c and mm/swap.h, replace flat VM_SPARSE array with 2-level RCU radix chunks: si->cluster_dir[chunk_idx] points to struct swap_cluster_chunk holding 64 swap_cluster_info descriptors, and swap_cluster_lookup_rcu() dereferences via rcu_dereference(). In __free_cluster(), atomic_dec_and_test(&chunk->live_clusters) detects interior empty chunks, scheduling xswap_reclaim_work. The reclaim worker acquires si->xswap_lock and spin_lock(&si->lock), trylocks and unlinks clusters, atomically clears si->cluster_dir[chunk_idx] = NULL, and dispatches asynchronous kfree_rcu(chunk, rcu).
mechanism.falsifier: Exact-tree review shows lost lifetime protection, incorrect slot conflict handling, RCU UAF, lock inversion between si->lock and ci->lock, failure of any of the 17 correctness gates, or latency regression beyond calibrated noise.
